patch_list: Adds a searchable list of Netflix's hidden genre categories (the netflix.com/browse/genre codes) and opens any of them inside the app. Reachable from its own "Hidden Categories" icon and from a long-press shortcut on the Netflix icon.

Keeps a patched (re-signed) Netflix build from killing its own process a few seconds after launch. Loads a bundled in-process native hook that blocks the fatal signal Netflix's native integrity guard raises against itself, so the app runs…
Stops Netflix from auto-playing preview trailers while you browse, and from auto-advancing to the next episode. Each can be turned off on its own.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hides an active VPN from the app's checks on the phone.
Makes the app see a Wi-Fi connection when the phone is on mobile data.
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
